content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab Korea Limited to GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand, how will my annual leave entitlement change in terms of total days per year?","answer":"Your annual leave will increase from a maximum of 25 days per year in Korea to at least 20 days per year in New Zealand (4 weeks).","evidence_a":"Team members with 3+ years of service are entitled to one additional day for every two years continuously worked up to 25 days/year.","evidence_b":"Minimum: 4 weeks annual leave per year"}
